description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of generated samples and the Micro F1 score for four datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated” with a linear scale ranging from 8 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 8 (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64). The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

A blue line with circular markers represents TACRED, starting at approximately 34% at K=8 and increasing to approximately 30% at K=64. An orange line with triangular markers represents TACRED-Revisit, beginning at approximately 29% at K=8 and rising to approximately 35% at K=64. A brown line with diamond markers represents Re-TACRED, starting at approximately 26% at K=8 and increasing to approximately 51% at K=64. Finally, a red line with square markers represents SemEval, beginning at approximately 42% at K=8 and increasing to approximately 47% at K=64.
caption_used: Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs. The line plot shows the performance of four datasets: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64), while the y-axis shows Micro F1 (%) ranging from 20 to 50. TACRED and TACRED-Revisit exhibit similar trends, with TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforming TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes. Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64, while SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64. The legend in the top left corner maps each dataset to its corresponding line style and marker.
